name: Elias J. Corey

name: R. B. Woodward
summary: Harvard chemist and leading authority in organic synthesis during the mid-twentieth century.

summary: Postdoctoral fellow and collaborator of Corey on the LHASA program.

name: Jeff Howe
summary: Graduate student and collaborator of Corey on the LHASA program.

name: David Pensak
summary: Graduate student and collaborator of Corey on the LHASA program.

name: Xue-Min Cheng
summary: Postdoctoral fellow and co-author of Corey's textbook The Logic of Chemical Synthesis.

name: MIT
summary: University where Corey received his PhD.

name: Harvard University
summary: University where Corey spent over fifty years and developed retrosynthetic analysis.

aliases: Logic and Heuristics Applied to Synthetic Analysis
name: LHASA
